research_mode: official data.police.uk and Department for Transport primary sources only; anonymisation, provenance, API retrieval, STATS19 coverage, revision, severity and quality gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: STATS19 record-level dataset scope
verified_claims: open files provide record-level collision, vehicle and casualty data from 1979
limitations: the files describe reported road collisions and do not establish parcel safety

sources.name: STATS19 reported personal-injury scope
verified_claims: the statistics cover personal-injury collisions on public roads reported to police and recorded through STATS19
limitations: unreported collisions and non-injury events are outside this scope

sources.name: STATS19 final annual release cycle
verified_claims: final annual data are released after the annual reported road casualties publication
limitations: the release cycle is not a real-time road-safety feed

sources.name: STATS19 provisional mid-year data
verified_claims: mid-year files are provisional, not fully validated and subject to change
limitations: provisional records must not be mixed silently with final validated data

sources.name: STATS19 provisional duplicate caveat
verified_claims: provisional files can contain casualties logged more than once before year-end validation
limitations: duplicate screening is required before candidate aggregation

sources.name: STATS19 public-field privacy gate
verified_claims: the public files contain non-sensitive fields that can be released openly
limitations: absence of sensitive fields limits some causal or contributory analysis

sources.name: STATS19 sensitive-field access gate
verified_claims: sensitive fields such as contributory-factor data are handled through a separate approved-request process
limitations: restricted fields must not be inferred from public columns

sources.name: STATS19 coded-value decoding
verified_claims: open files use coded values and are accompanied by a data guide for decoding
limitations: raw codes must not be interpreted without the applicable guide version

sources.name: STATS19 injury-based reporting shift
verified_claims: injury-based reporting by some forces changed the reported severity distribution
limitations: unadjusted severity comparisons across reporting systems can be misleading

sources.name: STATS19 severity adjustment integration
verified_claims: severity adjustment values are included in the main data tables for the 2024 publication
limitations: adjusted and unadjusted severity fields must remain distinguishable

sources.name: STATS19 revision policy
verified_claims: apart from severity adjustments, data are not routinely revised although minor historic amendments can occur
limitations: a prior download can differ from the latest published file

sources.name: STATS19 junction-detail correction
verified_claims: a 2024 junction_detail recoding error was corrected in files republished in November 2025
limitations: older copies can contain the incorrect no-data recoding

sources.name: STATS19 restricted-lane known issue
verified_claims: some 2024 vehicle records can miscode lay-by or hard-shoulder locations as no data
limitations: affected rows must be checked against the published issue list

sources.name: STATS19 latest final validated year
verified_claims: the latest full year identified as final validated data is 2024
limitations: later provisional data should not be labelled final

sources.name: STATS19 collision vehicle casualty separation
verified_claims: collision, vehicle and casualty records are published as separate files
limitations: joins require the documented identifiers and must avoid multiplicative duplication
